text: たたかって　うんだめし　するか

structure.jp: うんだめし　するか

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.span: たたかって　うんだめし　する
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins two actions, the first being the way the second is done. たたかって うんだめし する = 'battle and test my luck'.

patterns.name: 〜か (deciding)
patterns.explanation: か after a plain verb, said to oneself, means 'shall I', as the speaker makes up his mind. するか = 'shall I do it'.
